profile.summary:
Bachelor of Arts Candidate for Computer Science and East Asian Studies at New York University 18'. Raised in Seoul, Hong Kong. Graduate of St. Paul's School 11'. Native English speaker. 

Long term ambitions: software engineering, entrepreneurship
Hobbies: Football (soccer), languages, translating, whisky

positions.description:

- Added mock DynamoDB testing to Amazon API test suite using DynamoDBLocal

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:

positions.description:

- Created unit tests for all features and participated in all steps of software development life cycle

projects.title: Footy
projects.description:
A web app that scrapes popular soccer highlight videos for search criteria, which in turn is used to query for youtube soccer highlights using youtube's API. Additionally, live goal updates from international fixtures and every soccer league around the world is notified in real-time. 
Github: https://github.com/sechoongkim/footy

projects.title: Paletro
projects.description:
A website builder that allows for dynamic, front-end and multi-purposed website generation. User projects may be saved and accessible via download upon creation. A project built with heavy emphases on  Angular.js on the frontend and Sequelize on the backend. 
Project link: https://paletro.herokuapp.com
